class.name: VoxelFieldData
class.brief_description: Sparse voxel levels of a far field, split into bricks, for [VoxelField3D].
class.description: Holds the voxel levels that [method VoxelProxyBuilder.build_field] builds. The voxel grid is a cube on the longest side of [member bounds], at its position. Level 0 has [member resolution] voxels along each edge of the cube; every coarser level halves that down to [member brick_resolution], where each brick holds one voxel. Each brick lists its voxels per level, so a renderer can pick one level per brick without gaps or overlaps between bricks. A voxel takes 16 bytes: its cell in the brick and its surface centroid in 1/16 of a voxel, its sRGB albedo, an octahedral normal and its splat half size. [b]Note:[/b] Experimental.

method.name: count_splats
method.description: Returns how many voxels [VoxelField3D] selects without frustum culling, summing [method select_level] over all bricks. Arguments as in [method select_level].

method.name: get_aabb
method.description: Returns [member bounds] grown by the farthest a splat can reach beyond its centroid.

method.name: get_brick_count
method.description: Returns the number of occupied bricks.

method.name: get_level_count
method.description: Returns the number of levels, from [member resolution] down to [member brick_resolution] voxels per edge.

method.name: get_level_voxel_count
method.description: Returns the number of voxels on [param level] over all bricks.

method.name: get_level_voxel_size
method.description: Returns the edge length of a voxel on [param level].

method.name: get_max_splat_count
method.description: Returns the most splats one selection can produce: for each brick, the voxel count of its largest level.

method.name: get_voxel
method.description: Returns voxel [param index] decoded as the GPU decodes it: [code]position[/code] (the splat centre), [code]half_size[/code], linear [code]color[/code], [code]normal[/code], and the [code]level[/code] and [code]brick[/code] it belongs to. Slow; meant for tests and tools.

method.name: get_voxel_count
method.description: Returns the number of voxels on all levels.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the properties are consistent: power-of-two resolutions, at most 64 finest voxels per brick edge, and brick ranges inside the voxel data. [VoxelField3D] draws nothing for invalid data.

method.name: select_level
method.description: Returns the level [VoxelField3D] picks for [param brick]: the coarsest level whose voxels are at most [param voxel_pixels] wide at the brick's nearest point, or level 0 when even that is wider. [param camera] is in the field's space. [param pixel_scale] is pixels per unit at distance 1 for a perspective camera (half the viewport height times the projection's Y scale), or pixels per unit when [param orthogonal] is [code]true[/code].

members.member: The region the voxels were built from. Splat centres lie inside it.
Bricks along each edge of the cube, and voxels along each edge on the coarsest level.
Per brick: its packed coordinates (10 bits per axis), then the first voxel and the voxel count of each level.
Voxels along each edge of the cube on the finest level.
The voxels of all bricks and levels, 16 bytes each.
